about: What character work must hold and what is next, read by `cargo xtask characters` (tools/characters/status.ts). checks: the checks whose results are recorded when they run (record.ts), each with the command that refreshes it, how long it takes and the files it reads (`owns`, git pathspecs: a commit to one makes its record stale). criteria: a row each, a stage of a check's record (`check` and `stage`), the build's verdict (`check: build`, failures matching a `known` fault's `match` allowed, each with why), or `live`, worked out from the catalogue as the status runs; `bar` says what passes. tasks: the work still to do, in order, each with the files that own it (`path#symbol` resolves to the symbol's line), the command that checks it and the criterion it moves, if any. A job that finishes a task takes its row out; one that finds work adds a row.

build.takes: 3 min, Blender; one build at a time; then git checkout -- assets/models/character/fight.glb

criteria.bar: every file of theirs byte for byte as SHA256SUMS lists, CC0 packs only (D599)
every vendored file the private repository's own bytes
no script that reshapes meshes can be given their files
every piece's source there, made on its body for its slot
every two pieces of a body measured, a row each
every joint of every piece on its body's skeleton
every look composed in every state of undress
no failure but the known ones (rig, clips, gear, morphs: build_verdict.ts)

known.why: the man's sprint skates 2.7/7.8 cm, known since char-switch j8

criteria.bar: every look wears its person's hair (wardrobe.json looks' `pieces.hair`)
hundreds of dressed figures a body, not millions (D182)
